criteria.text: Measured session-start token drop recorded (use the tokens-01 tool_surface_estimator for before/after).
criteria.reason: The tokens-01 estimator (apps/api_server/src/services/tool_surface_estimator.ts) estimates from role-file tool counts, not live engine schema bytes, so a true before/after token measurement requires a live signed-binary session per docs/ai/testing-guide.md 'MCP allowlist smoke'. This run records a deterministic analytical estimate (fixed per-tool schema-byte savings x tool count, derived from the same CHARS_PER_TOOL_ESTIMATE constant the estimator uses) in the run log as the recorded before/after, and flags the live-engine confirmation as the required manual follow-up smoke.
